author: Gian López
abstract: An executable, read-only skill that bridges Claude Code with the user's Neovim `audit` plugin. The plugin stores each project's review database in a single file at <git-root>/.git/audit.json, which this skill reads to report every source file's status (pending, done, or unaudited) and to enforce a guard that prevents Claude from modifying or proposing changes to files the user has already reviewed and marked `done`. Reading the same file the plugin writes keeps it as the single source of truth, with no duplicated storage logic that could silently drift
